description: Upsert a Salesforce record by external ID, creating or updating it based on the matching value. An update-only option prevents creation when no record matches.

field_name.description: The API name of the external ID field. This field must be marked as 'External ID' in Salesforce.
field_name.title: Field Name

field_value.description: The value of the external ID for the specific record to upsert.
field_value.title: Field Value

fields.description: JSON object containing the fields to create or update. Field names should be the Salesforce API names with their corresponding values.
fields.title: Fields

sobject.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact, CustomObject__c).
sobject.title: Sobject

update_only.description: Available in API v62.0+. When set to true, only updates existing records without creating new ones. Returns 404 if record doesn't exist.
update_only.title: Update Only

name: upsert_sobject_by_external_id

UpsertSobjectByExternalIdResponse.description:
Response from Salesforce upsert operation.

HTTP 204 No Content - Salesforce returns empty body on successful update.
HTTP 201 Created - Salesforce returns the created record ID (for insert).
Error responses (4xx/5xx) are handled via raise_for_status().

created.description: True if a new record was created. Only present for insert operations (201 Created).
created.title: Created

id.description: The Salesforce record ID (18-character ID). Only present for insert operations (201 Created).
id.title: Id
